title: WorkBuddy Buddy Edge Report Acknowledgement v1
description: A successful, server-authored acknowledgement for an accepted or exactly replayed Edge report envelope.
$comment: While the acknowledged boot remains current, an exact full-payload replay returns the same acknowledgement values and performs no new presence, lease, interval, or scoring side effects. A replay from a fenced boot is rejected as stale_boot and never returns its old ACK. accepted_through_sequence is scoped to the acknowledged instance and boot. server_received_at is server-authored and is the authoritative accounting boundary. current_protocol and min_supported_protocol describe the responding server, so a v1 Edge can receive future N/N-1 values; application validation enforces 1 <= min_supported_protocol <= current_protocol and the advertised support window.
